text: player

Early in the morning, as the first light of dawn descends upon the land, Champion Street is already filled with the hustle and bustle of everyday life. The constant hawking of vendors and the aroma of various delicacies flood the entire street and every alley.
Yet Champion Auction House is the only place that is enjoying "peace and quiet" on the bustling street, as there is a notice board at its entrance--Closed For The Morning.

Champion Auction House, a prestigious establishment that recently appeared on Champion Street, specializes in auctioning rare and priceless items. Rumor has it that the auction house is owned by Fuuka Minami, the proprietor of Bamboo Cloud. However, Fuuka Minami has remained silent on the legitimacy of those claims.

Flipping through the schedule in my hand, I realize today should be a business day for the auction house. Feeling a bit confused, I decide to search for an employee entrance to get inside and ask one of the auction house's staff for clarification.
Huh? Why won't it budge?
Although I unlocked the electronic lock with the access card, the door isn't budging at all, even when I push hard against it. It seems like... something is blocking it from the inside.
Just as I start to wrack my brain for a solution, I receive a call from Ume.
How are the preparations going at the auction house?
As soon as the call connects, Ume gets straight to the point and asks about my progress. I glance at the motionless door before me and lowered my voice guiltily.
I'm not sure if it's my access card that's acting up, but the auction house is closed, and I can't get in through the employee entrance either. So...
You can't get in, huh? Okay, I understand. Go get some breakfast at Bamboo Inn. I'll meet you there.

Although allowing your boss to personally resolve an issue is a risky move for a lowly employee like me, I don't have a better choice right now. I can't just force my way in, right? Ugh... Let's just get something to eat.

Bamboo Cloud has many restaurants throughout Champion Street, with each catering to different types of customers. For instance, Bamboo Inn, located by the auction house, is all about fast food, with a menu featuring roasted dishes and snacks. Mornings are their busiest times, and there's always a steady stream of people coming in.
I take a glance at the long line and start making my way toward the end of the line when one of the employees stops me.
Employee
{var:player_nickname}? Let me take another look at the photo... Yes, it is you.
Huh?
Ms. Ume gave our manager a call about your arrival. Everything has been prepared, please come with me.
Ume's efficiency is truly mind-blowing. I follow the employee inside under the envious gazes of the nearby crowd, all the way up to the second floor.
Wh-Why isn't there anyone else here?
You're a distinguished guest that Ms. Ume personally notified us about. We don't have private rooms in this restaurant, so our manager cleared out the second floor for you to dine in peace.
W-Wait a minute... I'm just a...
Don't worry about it, it's only right that we do this for you. If you're satisfied with your meal...
The employee approaches me and whispers with a wide grin on his face.

Please speak kindly of our restaurant to Ms. Minami and Ms. Ume. Even though we're positioned as a budget-friendly place, our annual income is quite impressive and we rank among the top earners. So, the year-end bonuses and dividends... Hehe.

I think I know what's going on now. Ume must have forgotten to explain who I am, so they've mistaken me for an inspector. But it's probably best not to say anything right now. Anyway... let's just get something to eat first.

The second floor has a great view. More than half of Champion Street is in view through the exquisite wooden lattice windows, including the nearby auction house. I even have a clear view of the entrance.
If they open up now, I can still make it... I wait for my breakfast to arrive while thinking about the work that is about to come.
Huh?
Are there two people on the second floor of the auction house? The view isn't very clear through the wooden grid window, so I push open the window beside me.
A woman is being strangled by a masked figure!!!

In a hurry, I stretch half my body out the window to get a closer look, and I see her bending down to pick something up before passing it to the person behind her. It's a bit too far away, so I couldn't see what exactly it was... After that, the masked figure strikes her on the head, and her figure crashes to the ground, vanishing from my sight.
A robbery?!
It's an emergency! What should I do?
Seek help from an employee.
Call the police.
Consult Ume.
What I just witnessed isn't enough to prove it was a robbery. But... Bamboo Inn is packed with customers, so someone must have seen something, right? Maybe I should talk to the employees here.
I rush downstairs to get the employee who led me inside earlier, and I bring him before the second-floor window.
...You jump, I jump?
The waiter slowly spreads his arms.
No! Look toward the second floor of the auction house!!!
Oh...
The employee sticks his head out to take a glance, then looks helplessly at me.
It looks the same as it was yesterday.
You didn't see a masked figure?
I pull him aside and take a look--The auction house is empty. Neither the masked figure nor the woman is in sight, only an open, empty window.
The auction house... How could this be? Wait! I'm sure someone else saw it!
You can only see the street from the first floor, and the auction house is only visible from the second floor. But since you're the only customer on the second floor...
I don't know what happened, but please calm down. No matter what happens, Shrimp Dumpling is here to help!
How will shrimp dumplings help me?
The employee gives me a big grin with most of his teeth showing.
Well, I'm Shrimp Dumpling, my dear customer.
And I'm Fried Leek Dumpling!
The waiter shows me a face full of doubt toward my declaration and goes downstairs worriedly. I manage to overhear through the door...
Don't just stand there! Serve our VIP on the second floor immediately! We can't have the customer hallucinate from hunger!
I'm definitely filing a complaint about Shrimp Dumpling to Fuuka Minami!

However, as my chaotic thoughts begin to settle, I realize that if it really was a robbery, it would be a major incident. Everything on display in the auction house is to be auctioned off during Bamboo Cloud's Annual Charity Auction... I should give Ume a call!
Just as I'm about to make the call, Ume beats me to it.

Everything on display in the auction house is extremely valuable and is scheduled to be auctioned off during Bamboo Cloud's Annual Charity Auction... In a situation like this, calling the police is the best choice.
I get my phone. Just as I'm about to make the call to the police, I receive a call from Ume.

Everything on display in the auction house is extremely valuable and is scheduled to be auctioned off during Bamboo Cloud's Annual Charity Auction... Since I suspect a robbery may have occurred, I should let Ume know.
How's your breakfast?
I haven't gotten it yet, but there might be a problem...
If the breakfast isn't to your liking, you can email a complaint to me.
That's not what I mean! And don't hang up!
For employee salary concerns, please transfer the call to Take. For employee safety concerns, please transfer the call to Kiku. For collaborations with Bamboo Cloud, please transfer the call to Ran.
Other concerns! Other!
For other concerns, please wait two hours.
There's been a robbery!!!
What robbery?
I think I saw a robbery go down on the second floor of the auction house. But it was too far away for me to be absolutely certain...
Ume falls silent for a moment. She seems to be covering her mic and speaking to someone else, and it takes her a minute to get back to me.
I've notified Ms. Fuuka. Please do not call the police for now.
After all, whether this is true or not, rumors of valuable items being lost at an auction house will inevitably lead to unnecessary losses for the business.
You can head over to the auction house first. Just focus on guarding the scene. We'll be there soon.
Fuuka Minami, Ume, and I practically arrive at the same time. As soon as we step through the door, Ume swiftly checks the security system and discovers that the surveillance system has been damaged.
Fuuka Minami
Let's head up to the second floor.
A terrified woman in uniform, with her hands and feet tied, is curled up in the corner by the window.
Fuuka Minami goes straight for the display cabinet while Ume and I rush over to untie the woman.
I turn around and notice that the window beside me is facing directly at Bamboo Inn, so this must be the "scene of the crime" that I witnessed earlier.
Ume
Aoi, is it?
Aoi
*sobbing* Ms. Ume... I can't believe you still remember me... You took pity on me and brought me here when I was twelve...
Your name is on your uniform.
Why did you close the auction house without authorization this morning?
Ms. Ume, it wasn't my doing... I-I woke up to noise coming from the second floor, so I went to check. That's when I saw a masked figure picking a cabinet's lock...

At that moment... I was so scared that I turned around and ran. But when I got to the employee entrance, it was blocked with a stick. *sobbing* He caught me before I could even get out, and then he made me open the cabinet...
So that's why I couldn't push open the employee entrance's door...

Under Ume's instruction, I walk over to the only open cabinet at the scene, and there are indeed some scratches on the metal lock. I stand up and nod toward Ume's direction, and she continues questioning Aoi.
What time did you get to the auction house this morning?
I-I never left... There was a huge storm last night, so I couldn't make it home and decided to spend the night in the employee lounge.
Were you alone here last night?
Aoi nods, and Ume flips through the employee log.
She was indeed the only one here. There was supposed to be another male employee, Toku, but he injured his leg a few days ago and has been on leave this week.
This auction house is equipped with a state-of-the-art security system and comprehensive surveillance without any blind spots, so we don't keep many staff on site.
After saying that, Ume abruptly looks down and sneers before continuing.
To be able to disable these security systems, the thief must be very familiar with them.
Can you describe the thief's appearance?
What kind of mask?
A vermillion bird beak mask!
Hint Received - [Vermillion Bird Beak Mask]
Meanwhile, Fuuka Minami finishes her inspection of the display cabinets and quietly folds the folding fan in her grasp. As she lightly taps the glass cabinet, a subtle smile appears on her face.
Well, the good news is only one item is missing.
The bad news is it's the Heart of Divinity.
That heart of something... What is it?
The Heart of Divinity. A matchless, pearl-white jade that is naturally shaped like a heart. It's worth a fortune and is supposed to be the final item in the auction.
It had just arrived the night before yesterday, and now it's been stolen... The thief clearly knew what they were doing. It's as if they had specifically targeted it.
Are you saying...
Apart from us, the guests who attended yesterday's exhibition are the only ones who've seen the jade.
Noticing my bewilderment, Ume continues to explain.

Since you just started this job, it's understandable that you might not know about this. All items are put on exhibition here before the auction, and guests come every day to view them. This allows them to find items they like in advance and makes bidding easier during the auction.
After saying that, Ume purses her lips before turning hesitantly to Fuuka Minami to continue.
But...

But... yesterday's guests were either specially invited experts in antiques or renowned figures from One Han City. So, even if they coveted it, they would never do something like this... Hehe, that's what you wanted to say, right?
So, are you saying those people from yesterday... looked all respectable but were actually scumbags? Unbelievable!
See? Ume? Even your employee understands. Human greed goes far beyond your imagination.
Sorry, I should have been more careful. How do you intend to deal with this matter, Ms. Fuuka?
Manage Bamboo Cloud's affairs for me. I'll take over from here.
As for this auction house... Shut it down for the next three days and set up a cordon outside. No one is allowed to enter or leave without my permission.
Oh, what about me? I'm just an eyewitness, and I've told you everything...
Of course you have special privileges, {var:player_nickname}.
Phew...
After all, as my personal secretary and supervisor of the auction, you're duty-bound to find the criminal and retrieve the Heart of Divinity!
Me?
Fuuka Minami pats me on the shoulder with a smile on her face, then she gives me a look of confidence before leaving...
Ume hesitates for a moment and passes me a copy of the [VIP Exhibition Invitation List] before rushing after Fuuka Minami.
Hint Received - [VIP Exhibition Invitation List]
I flip through the list, and to my surprise, I notice a few familiar names--Saturne, Qing Luan, Chiori Mikami, Riu Kujou, Miki Nikaidou...
What time did the guests on this list arrive on the day of the exhibition?
G-Give me a moment. All guest arrivals are logged. I'll get it for you.

I follow Aoi to the computer in the first-floor lobby to view the guest log. We discover that everyone but Saturne has been to the scene. After memorizing this clue, I put the invitation list away and start investigating the scene of the crime.

Besides the cabinet that had been stolen from, nothing seems out of the ordinary on the second floor. No obvious traces can be found in the first-floor lobby either. But as I arrive at the auction house's entrance, something on the ground catches my attention...
Oh! The auction was coming up, and Ms. Minami wanted to grow a flower bed. We just laid new soil here last week!

It seems last night's heavy rain made the soil wet and muddy. I squat down to take a closer look at the footprints... Based on their shape, there seem to be four different sets of footprints--One which is clearly my own, while the other three include two sets of footprints from high heels and a final set that looks like it's from sports shoes.
I turn around to glance at Aoi's feet. She's wearing a pair of flat, black leather shoes. Obviously, her footprints aren't here.
I recall the moment I entered the auction house with Fuuka Minami and Ume earlier, and I realize both sets of high heel footprints belong to them. As for the final set of footprints...
This set of footprints is around 26 centimeters long, is heading outward, and is possibly male. The gap between each step is over a meter, so the owner must have been running.
I ask Aoi for a sheet of blank paper, and I use it to take an impression of the footprint's rough outline and sole design. This might become the key to this case.
Hint Received - [Footprint likely from a man]

After that, Aoi and I carefully inspect the area once more but don't find any other clues. After giving it some thought, I decide to start by visiting the guests on the invitation list. Who knows? Maybe I'll find some useful information from them.
After visiting a few of the guests on the list, I still have nothing to show for it. The next guest on my list happens to be a familiar face--Qing Luan.
I head to Beryl Blue, yet I find Fuuka Minami leaning against its door with a frown on her face. She crosses her arms and moves aside upon noticing my arrival.
You're finally here. Your investigation is a little behind schedule.
Then... Why don't I leave Qing Luan to you? And I'll hurry off to the next guest.
Fuuka Minami closes her folding fan with a snap and takes a step forward to obstruct my path.
That won't do. I'm here to supervise your work, my little detective.
I try to argue, but in the end, I decide to just shut my mouth and do my job, avoiding any argument with my boss.
I take a few steps forward and knock on Beryl Blue's door. A yellow cockatiel flies out from within, Qing Luan's bird--Yellow Tea.
Yellow Tea flies over to me and leads me inside while Fuuka Minami follows.
Good day.
In the quiet house, droplets of spring water resound through the room, and at the center of the room is an ebony tea table so smooth it shines like black jade.

Behind the tea table, a glimpse of a cyan skirt catches the eye. A jade-white hand steadily lifts the teapot, pouring boiling water and releasing the refreshing aroma of tea into the air. It's none other than Qing Luan, the owner of Beryl Blue.
Qing Luan
Ms. Minami... Since you disregarded my polite refusal, don't be surprised if my hospitality falls short from now on.
Oh, Qing Luan. I see you haven't changed a bit.

Fuuka Minami sweeps away the tea's steam with her fan and walks over to the tea table while Qing Luan rolls up her sleeves and stands up slowly. Meanwhile, Yellow Tea flies over to her finger, raises its tail feathers, and chirps incessantly at Fuuka Minami. The atmosphere in the room suddenly turns tense...
I think I've come at the wrong time...
I should run! Now!
However, Qing Luan and Fuuka Minami suddenly glare at me...
It's the perfect time.
Anyway, amid this strange atmosphere, the three of us sit down before the tea table.
Of course, go ahead. I'll brew you a cup of Ming Qian Longjing tea.
Huh? I don't want to trouble you.
It's fine. Not drinking tea doesn't fit the atmosphere here.
But I'm sure you won't mind that I've brought my own tea leaves, right?
Feel free. But please use your own teaware as well.
This is an exclusive Da Hong Pao tea from Magical Dream. Would you like to try some, {var:player_nickname}?
This Da Hong Pao tea is delicate, rich, and extremely aromatic. Each pack goes for an astronomical sum.
Even an astronomical sum isn't enough to get my Ming Qian Longjing tea which is mellow, rounded, and has a pronounced aroma. It boils down to your own preference.
Fuuka Minami and Qing Luan push their brewed tea before me... Which one should I drink?
Da Hong Pao
Ming Qian Longjing
Both
Excellent taste. I would expect nothing less from my personal secretary.
Personal secretary?
A hint of worry appears on Qing Luan's face.
Have you been... having cash flow issues lately?
Let's focus on the auction house for now!
Hehe, your taste is as good as ever.
Hmm... Looks like your taste is in need of some special training. It's a basic requirement for any employee of Bamboo Cloud.
If you forcibly entangle things that should stay apart, I'm afraid the outcome given by fate will not be a satisfactory one.
Oho, trying to stay impartial? As far as Bamboo Cloud is concerned, showing kindness to a competitor will only harm our own interests. Such things are absolutely PRO--HI--BI--TED.
How barbaric...
Let's stay on topic and discuss the auction house for now. Let's allow the little detective to decide who's the really barbaric one.
I see. Please go ahead then.
[Footprint likely from a man]
[Receipt (Plaster)]
[Receipt (Bandage)]
[Vermillion Bird Beak Mask]
[VIP Exhibition Invitation List]
Take a look for yourself. Does it look like my footprint?
Larger feet can be squeezed into smaller shoes, so why can't smaller feet be put into larger shoes?
Ms. Minami, I see you're well-versed in making baseless accusations... huh? Hehe.
Plaster... Beryl Blue has no need for that.
Oh? Don't you need it to fix up those treasures of yours?
Heh, plaster is only used to fix up forgeries. I see you're quite knowledgeable on the subject, Ms. Minami.
I haven't been to a pharmacy recently.
How can you prove that?
The little guys here usually get their medicine from the pet hospital.
Heh, you should keep it for yourself, Qing Luan. After all, you have more need for it than I do.
A strangely-shaped vermillion mask? I would never keep something like that.
But I see you have quite the collection of strangely-shaped items.
Ms. Minami, if you're able to keep this and live a few millennia, then maybe I'd be willing to keep it.
I did attend the exhibition yesterday, but I wasn't the only one there. That doesn't seem to prove anything, does it?
It seems none of your clues have anything to do with me.
The footprint and the like may not, but how can we be sure your bird didn't take the jade while you hired someone to stage a robbery?
Yellow Tea is a cockatiel, not a crow that loves shiny objects, or an insatiable phoenix.
So, what's your conclusion, little detective?
I'm sure you'll make a fair judgment based on the facts.

I glance at both of them. One is my current boss, and the other is a good friend... In my mind, two mini versions of me are fighting violently against each other. One is telling me to tell the truth and receive a quick death, and the other is telling me to lie because only death awaits anyway. In the end, I decide...
Hmm... Isn't it too hasty to come to a conclusion right now?
Ms. Minami, I'm honored by the visit. But I think that if you're here to convict me of a crime I did not commit, then this discussion is over.
Besides... Are you really unaware of the truth about the Heart of Divinity?
I hate beating around the bush. Wouldn't someone who knows that truth be the thief? So, do you know the truth, Qing Luan?
Please leave... Beryl Blue is closed to visitors at noon.
The current evidence is insufficient to prove that Qing Luan is unrelated to the case...
I've been playing Go with Yellow Tea all morning, and I have nothing else to say.
Besides... Are you really unaware of the truth about the Heart of Divinity, Ms. Minami?
I hate beating around the bush. Wouldn't someone who knows that truth be the thief? So, do you know the truth, Qing Luan?
Kicked out by Qing Luan, Fuuka Minami and I are left staring at each other at Beryl Blue's door. She strokes the tassels on her fan and suddenly smiles.
Do you think I went too far back there?
I nod in response, and then I stiffly shake my head under the dissatisfied stare from Fuuka Minami.
You're so honest and adorable. But I didn't go too far. She's always been like that, and we've been at odds for quite some time now. You should get used to it.
She taps me on the shoulder with her fan, and I think I see a hint of gloating in her smile, as if she's waiting to see what happens...
I have a customer to meet, so I won't be following you the rest of the way. Little detective, don't slack off even if I'm not there to supervise you, okay?
Don't worry, boss.

After receiving a satisfactory answer, Fuuka Minami turns around and leaves. I shoot a glance at Beryl Blue's tightly closed door behind me, wondering how I should explain everything to Qing Luan after all this.
Sigh... It was so intense. I guess only those who witnessed it firsthand could truly understand how terrifying they were.
I should head off to the next guest on the list while it's still bright outside. Let's see who's next...
Riu Kujou
That's the price you pay for offending Miss Chiori.
Riu Kujou puts me into a chokehold, and I speak my last words while losing consciousness--
I'm really just here... to ask a few questions...
I arrive at the home of the next guest on the list, Chiori Mikami.
Ten Minutes Ago
As soon as I walk in, I notice a mask on the tea table in the living room--vermillion with a bird's beak, a mirror image of Aoi's description!
Where did you get that mask?
Chiori Mikami
You want it?
Hmph! You can have it. Riu, pack it up for {var:player_nickname}.
Wait! Don't touch it! It's an important piece of evidence!
What evidence?
I'll make it quick! An important item was stolen from Champion Auction House, and the thief was wearing this mask! So, where did you get...
A masked... thief?
And you think Riu is that thief...
Chiori Mikami's face flushes red.
Or do you think I'm the thief?
Eh? Wait! That's not what I mean...
The Present
Riu Kujou releases me. I rub my neck--I really should watch what I say!
So, have you figured out anything yet?
Riu, don't speak to {var:player_nickname}. {var:player_nickname}... is the worst! Hmph!

Chiori Mikami seems to have been hurt by my comment about the thief wearing the mask. No matter how I apologize, she just keeps her back to me, silently fiddling with the board game in front of her...
Riu Kujou shakes her head.
Riu Kujou shakes her head again with a serious expression on her face.
Forget it! If it'll take even longer than that, she might as well have me begging on my knees!
But my conversation with Riu Kujou gives me an idea.
Riu Kujou nods.
Well... That makes sense, I suppose. It doesn't really provide any useful information.
Riu Kujou compares the sole of her shoe with the footprint, and it's clearly larger than hers.
Riu Kujou seems to read my mind and waves her fists at me. She does make a good point, it doesn't look like a footprint that Chiori Mikami could ever leave behind...
I guess this clue has nothing to do with them.
Riu Kujou gives it a glance and shakes her head in confusion.
It doesn't seem like I'll be getting any useful information here.
Riu Kujou nods, then immediately shakes her head anxiously. The sight of this puzzles me quite a bit.
Riu Kujou starts writing in the air for quite a while. It's clear to me she wants to explain, but I don't understand any of it! I guess picking up sign language really is necessary...
Let's just move on to the next question.
Riu Kujou takes a glance and nods.
I guess this clue has nothing to do... Wait! What?!
Did you go together?
Was someone injured?
Riu Kujou nods.
Was it Chiori?
Riu Kujou shakes her head and points at her arm.
Riu Kujou nods and points at her arm.
So Riu Kujou got injured? But what happened?
Does your injury have anything to do with the exhibition?
Did you get injured while doing housework?
Did someone cause that injury?
Riu Kujou tilts her head in frustration, clearly finding it ridiculous that I've linked her injury to the exhibition.
If it's unrelated... Then how?
Riu Kujou raises her brows threateningly at me. She seems to consider my assumption an insult to her abilities as a maid.
If I keep this up, I'll be the one ending up injured. So, how did she injure herself?
Riu Kujou shakes her head without hesitation.
Hmm, she must be saying no one's her match. Then how did she injure herself?
Riu Kujou notices my confusion and skillfully demonstrates a series of Taekwondo moves.
I think I know what happened. I did just experience that technique for myself.
So, you injured yourself while practicing Taekwondo?
Riu Kujou nods proudly, seemingly as if it wasn't an injury but a badge of honor.
Judging by the chokehold she put me in earlier, her arm should be fine now.
After asking several questions and getting nowhere, Chiori Mikami turns around impatiently just as I'm about to move to my next question.
Stop playing tricks right under my nose! I guess I have no choice but to tell you everything!
Fake detective! Get over here! Let me see the evidence that's making you suspect us!
I do as she says and show her all the evidence I have...
The invitation list? Hmph! What's so surprising about Riu and I being on it?
A receipt? Plaster? I've only seen medical plaster. I'm not sure what this is.
Hmm, it might be the type used for making models?
I've never seen it in my life.
Miss Chiori only goes for premium and custom models, most of which are made from pure gold or jade. Give me a moment... Well, I don't recall anything made of plaster.
Never mind...
But this receipt does look like it belongs to Riu.
It does seem like the same store! After I injured myself during Taekwondo practice, Miss Chiori and I went to a pharmacy to get bandages.
Ah, I can't believe I didn't keep the receipt this time. How strange... It's obviously a precious memory with Miss Chiori, so how could I have lost it?!
{var:player_nickname}, can I have it back?
While it may seem unrelated to the case for now, I must keep it safe until the case is closed. I promise to return it once the case is closed and it's proven to be unrelated to the case!
You're the best, {var:player_nickname}.
At this point, the nice comments I've received can be made into a set of mahjong. Sigh...
As I attempt to retrieve the receipt, I notice Riu Kujou holding tightly to the other end without any intention of letting it go.
Riu Kujou nods and starts writing in the air again, but I still can't make sense of what she's trying to convey. Luckily, Chiori Mikami can't stand to watch us flounder any longer.
Riu is trying to tell you that she wants that receipt!
Upon seeing Chiori Mikami finally calm down and willingly speak to us, Riu Kujou finally starts speaking normally again.
After I injured myself during Taekwondo practice, Miss Chiori and I went to a pharmacy to get bandages.
Ah, I can't believe I didn't keep the receipt this time. How strange... It's obviously a precious memory with Miss Chiori, so how could I have lost it?!
As for the mask that made you suspect us...
Forget it! You're such a dumb detective! I don't even feel like telling you!
Not even now?!
Chiori Mikami gives Riu Kujou a nod, and the latter pulls open the cabinet to reveal a pile of vermillion bird masks...
The *inaudible* theater near the auction house hands out these masks to the audience. Everyone who's been there can have one...
Chiori Mikami whispers its name so softly I fail to hear it.
Which theater?
Its name isn't important. All you need to know is that the theater hands out these masks!
They hand out these ugly masks for every show! And my mother just happens to be really fond of going there every vacation...
I still need to know which theater it is. Please tell me, it's very important for my investigation!
Chiori Mikami gazes at me, purses her lips, then turns around and shouts at the top of her lungs.
You're so annoying! It's the children's theater! You just had to make me say it! I hate you, {var:player_nickname}! You are the worst! THE WORST!
Sorry...
It turns out it was all just a big misunderstanding.
Damn {var:player_nickname}! How could you suspect that I would wear this... this... this thing... and commit a robbery?!
I now know it wasn't you.
That isn't the issue! It's this ugly mask! I even suggested last year they change it to a bear! Why didn't they go with my idea?!
I now realize I wasn't the cause of Chiori Mikami's anger, it was mainly the mask... Now that I'm taking a closer look, it does look rather ugly.
It's almost nighttime by the time I finally manage to calm them down and leave Chiori Mikami's place.
Since so many people could have these masks, their value as evidence is rather limited. I take a look at the time and decide it would be wise to just continue my investigation tomorrow.
Bamboo Inn - Second Floor
Champion Auction House

The second floor is where the items up for auction are exhibited. Once we ascend the spiral staircase in the lobby, we notice that most of the display cabinets are intact, and only one by the window is open.
Champion Auction House - Second Floor
He was wearing a mask. I-I couldn't see his face... And his voice was really strange. It sounded like he was using a voice changer. His voice sounded kind of... kind of like a girl...
Ume frowns upon hearing this and quickly walks to the display cabinet. I follow suit, and notice a shallow, heart-shaped groove on the red silk in the cabinet.
